decisions.decision: By consensus, the Committee will hear from various departments first and then schedule site visits in early December.
decisions.quote: consensus was to hear from various departments and then schedule site visits in early december.

decisions.decision: The Committee will meet with departments from the end of October to the beginning of December, review all requests in mid-December, and aim to finalize its recommendation by mid-January; the Town Manager will give the recommendation to the Select Board in late January.
decisions.quote: committee will meet with departments between end of october to the beginning of december.

decisions.decision: The Committee will meet every Tuesday until November 30, 2021, except November 16 because of Special Town Meeting; the Town Manager will schedule departments.
decisions.quote: committee will meet every tuesday between now and november 30, 2021 (except november 16th, due to special town meeting).

decisions.decision: The Town Manager will review and finalize the capital request documents with departments.
decisions.quote: town manager will review and finalize the documents

decisions.decision: Additional FY23 capital applications will not be accepted after the deadline unless there is an emergency.
decisions.quote: unless there is an emergency, additional applications will not be accepted.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager said capital funding comes from the operating budget, the special purpose stabilization fund and certified free cash, and that free cash has been certified at 2.6 million.
budget_items.quote: the budget process has not yet begun, free cash has been certified at 2.6 million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An IT consultant engaged to assess Town technology needs was funded through the operating budget; no amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: cost of the consultant was funded through the operating budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: No bids were received for two chapters of the master plan; the Planning project's estimated cost is 110,000, and putting the whole project out to bid is estimated to total $153,000 using funds left in a prior capital item.
budget_items.quote: total cost is estimated at $153,000, funds remaining in prior capital item will be utilized.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: New FY23 Town Manager project with an estimated cost of 40,000.
New FY23 Town Facilities project with an estimated cost of 100,000.
New FY23 Police projects: a K-9 at 24,250 (the K-9 is retiring) and a marked new police vehicle at 67,805.
budget_items.quote: police k-9 24,250 k-9 jerry is retiring

budget_items.what_was_recorded: New FY23 Police project for a marked new police vehicle at 67,805.

budget_items.topic: PSB drainage and pavement repair (future year)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Future-year Town Facilities project to repair drainage and pavement at the rear of the PSB building, estimated at 150,000 for FY2024.
budget_items.quote: psb repair drainage &pavement rear of building 150,000 fy2024

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Future-year Highway projects: Northfield Road culvert survey, design and permitting at 90,000 for FY2025, and culvert construction at 750,000 for FY2026.
The Flat Hill Road culvert project is on hold because allocated funds are insufficient based on bids received; the Town will apply to the small bridge program. No amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: is on hold since the allocated funds are not sufficient for the project (based on the bids received).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Committee member said an additional $25,000 for surveying Marshall Park should be included in the FY23 Capital Plan.
budget_items.quote: an additional $25,000 for surveying marshall park should be included in the fy23 capital plan

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager said the Special Stabilization fund should have sufficient funds to cover replacing Squad 3 and Rescue 1; no amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: heather lemieux informed the committee that the special stabilization fund should have sufficient funds to cover the replacement of squad 3 and rescue 1.
